name: validate_blue_king_count
description: Compares a blue piece-count value against a limit, then scans an eight-entry offset table for a conflicting square; on failure it returns the shared message pointer, otherwise it calls two routines and returns a zero or message result. The referenced text reports that blue has too many kings.

name: validate_red_king_presence
description: Checks a red piece count and scans an eight-entry offset table for a match, returning the shared message pointer or a follow-up result. The referenced text says red needs a king.

name: validate_blue_king_presence
description: Checks a blue piece count and then calls two routines to decide between the shared message pointer and a zero result. The referenced text says blue needs a king.

name: check_kings_adjacent
description: Scans an eight-entry offset table for the other king's square and returns the shared message pointer when a match is found, otherwise it calls two routines. The referenced text reports that the kings are adjacent.

name: detect_blue_in_check
description: Scans an eight-entry offset table for an attacking square and returns the message pointer when one matches; otherwise it calls two routines to decide the result. The referenced text reports that blue is in check.

name: stub_red_check_message
description: Returns the shared message pointer without any test, so it only yields a fixed value. The referenced text reads 'Red is in Check.', but the body contains no check.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns a 32-bit zero with no other work. It is a trivial result routine.

name: clear_status_word_after_calls
description: Calls two routines and then sets a 16-bit status word in the game data area to zero.

name: return_minimum_of_halves
description: Compares the lower and upper 16-bit halves of a 32-bit parameter, copies the lower into the upper when it is smaller, and returns the upper half, which is the smaller value.

name: return_maximum_of_halves
description: Compares the upper and lower 16-bit halves of a 32-bit parameter, copies the lower into the upper when the upper is smaller, and returns the upper half, which is the larger value.

name: compute_absolute_value
description: Negates the lower 16-bit half of a 32-bit parameter when it is zero or negative and returns it, which gives the magnitude of a signed value.

name: search_list_for_zero_result
description: Adjusts a counter, calls two routines, then walks a byte-counted list calling a comparison on each entry. It returns one when an entry compares to zero and zero when the list runs out first.

name: handle_turn_end_outcome
description: When a board test fails, it calls a message callback with one code; otherwise it swaps two stored side-index words, updates a third when a flag is set, and calls the message callback with another code. The referenced texts are 'Check and mate...Game over.' and 'Stalemate. How boring!!'

name: search_candidate_move_entries
description: Saves a pair of stored coordinates, loads a candidate from the current table entry and tests it with a comparison routine. When the test passes it scans the per-index table for a matching value and records it; otherwise it restores the saved pair.

name: unpack_square_flag_bits
description: Reads a two-byte table entry at an index, stores the first byte in a state word, and splits the second byte into two 2-bit fields and three single-bit flags. It then calls two routines.

name: pack_square_flag_bits
description: Writes a stored byte and a combined byte into a table entry, folding three flag words and two 2-bit fields into the second byte. The bit layout matches the one the unpacking routine reads.

name: begin_state_six_transition
description: Returns zero when the state byte is one or six or the stored word is zero; otherwise it sets the state byte to six, clears the word, calls a comparison routine, stores a nonzero result and returns one.

name: handle_indexed_status_callbacks
description: When an indexed status word equals two, it invokes two function-pointer callbacks on a record address, then calls two routines with a stored byte and a stored word.

name: read_byte_at_offset
description: Calls one function pointer with a base pointer plus a 16-bit offset, then calls a second function pointer to read one byte into a local, which it returns.

name: compare_byte_arrays_equal
description: Calls a comparison routine with the two parameters and returns true when its result is zero, which means the arrays are identical.

name: reset_piece_list_table
description: Calls a function pointer with the address of the piece-list table and a zero fill value, which resets that table through an external routine.

name: initialize_square_tables
description: Fills 120 four-byte entries with the value sixteen, clears a two-by-sixteen byte grid, and sets two 16-bit words to minus one before calling a routine with two table addresses.

name: index_pieces_by_type
description: Sweeps the board table and, for each piece whose type byte matches the current type from one to six, stores its square into a per-type list and increments that list's count. It calls two routines around the sweep.

name: note_missing_routine_body
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The routine has 24 instructions, is called by two routines and lists no calls, so its behaviour cannot be stated from this evidence.

name: swap_piece_table_entries
description: Swaps two four-byte entries of the piece table, selected by the two halves of the parameter, then writes the second parameter's byte into the square grid at the position recorded for the first entry.

name: clear_piece_table_entry
description: Sets the type byte of a piece-table entry to zero and clears the matching square byte in the board grid, using the position stored in that entry.

name: set_piece_table_entry
description: Stores a value and a second byte into a four-byte piece-table entry selected by one parameter, then writes the value into the board square computed from the stored position and a second parameter.

name: update_per_type_maximum
description: Stores a byte in a piece-table entry and in the board square it refers to, then raises the stored per-type value to the entry's word when that word is larger.

name: dispatch_square_update_calls
description: Chooses among several update calls based on two flag parameters and the piece type, and in the type-six case packs a row and column pair into a single square index before calling a routine.

name: build_direction_ray_table
description: Clears a lookup table with a called routine, then fills it with ray entries: for each of eight direction offsets it stores multiples of that offset and a combined value for each step.

name: check_path_clear_for_move
description: Tests whether a piece can move between two squares. Type six defers to a called routine, types one and five succeed when the direction mask matches, and other types step along the direction and return one only when they reach the target before meeting an occupied square.

name: check_neighbour_marked_piece
description: Steps a square by a stored offset and checks the two neighbouring table entries for a marked piece with the matching side byte, returning one when either is found.

name: test_pieces_in_list
description: When a first test on a value fails, walks the piece list for the given type from its last entry downward, returning one on the first entry that passes a test on its square and zero when none pass. It returns one immediately when the first test succeeds.

name: note_missing_routine_body
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The routine has 36 instructions, is called by two routines and calls one listed routine, so its behaviour cannot be stated from this evidence.

name: search_recent_move_records
description: Checks a piece-table entry against two parameter values, then walks backward through saved move records while each record is marked, returning the index of a matching record or a flag when none matches.

name: validate_piece_state
description: Returns true when the word at offset four is zero, the byte at offset seven is zero, and the byte at offset six is neither zero nor six.

name: count_consecutive_matching_entries
description: Counts back through the saved move records starting from the current depth, incrementing the count while a test on each record passes, and returns the count.

name: count_matching_record_pairs
description: Walks the saved record list downward from the current depth, checks pairs of entries for matching values and calls routines on each candidate, returning a count of qualifying steps or one when an early condition applies.

name: stub_gap_word_read
description: Returns a 16-bit value from the stack frame at an offset of minus two. The entry lies in a gap that decodes as code and is never called from a recovered routine, so it is likely decoded data.

name: validate_candidate_move
description: Checks a candidate move between a source and a destination square against the piece table, using a path test and special cases for one piece type, and returns one when the move passes and zero otherwise. It branches on several flag bytes.

name: append_candidate_move_entry
description: Appends the current pair of stored values to a list of up to eighty entries and advances the list counter, doing nothing once the list is full.

name: run_piece_type_sweep
description: Sets a mode flag, calls a routine for each piece-type value from two to five, then clears the flag.

name: collect_candidate_attackers
description: Records the piece type at a stored square, then checks the squares adjacent to a stored offset for a king-type piece of the matching side. It walks that side's piece list testing each non-king piece with a called routine and records the first success.

name: generate_moves_for_piece
description: Looks up the piece on a stored square and generates its destination squares by type: single-step offset tables for two types, ray sweeps for the middle types, and king steps with a castling check for type six. A called routine receives each reachable square.

name: generate_move_candidates_for_side
description: Clears the candidate list, walks the piece list of the side to move and records each piece's candidates, then handles one piece type with a threshold of thirty-one before calling a routine on each candidate.

name: pop_next_stored_pair
description: Returns the next stored pair from a list while the read index is below the count, and otherwise loads a default pair.

name: extract_lowest_bit
description: Returns the lowest bit of the lower 16-bit half of a 32-bit parameter.

name: evaluate_position_score
description: Sums each side's piece values from a lookup table, then adds a centre term and attack-map contributions for each square of the padded board, and combines them into one evaluation. The decompiled body is cut off in the source, so the later terms are not shown.

name: count_passing_bits_in_word
description: Shifts a 16-bit parameter right one bit at a time and calls a routine for each step, adding one to a count whenever that routine returns nonzero. It returns the total count.

name: compute_negated_weighted_sum
description: Calls three routines and returns the negative of a weighted sum: the first value times eight, the second times twenty and the third times forty.

name: lookup_piece_square_score
description: Computes a table offset from a piece type, a row and a column, then returns the stored word at that position added to the base value for the piece type.

name: clear_mask_bits_return_difference
description: Copies a stored mask word, clears its bits from two stored mask words for one square and direction, then calls two routines and returns the difference of their results.

name: set_mask_bits_return_difference
description: Copies a stored mask word, sets and clears bits in a pair of stored mask words for one square and direction, then calls two routines and returns the difference of their results.

name: score_move_positional_delta
description: Computes the positional score change for a move from its piece type and squares, using a per-type bonus for type one, a king-distance term for type six, and a column term for other pieces, then adjusts for special cases and returns the difference of two stored values.

name: run_iterative_root_search
description: Initialises the search state for the current position, then loops over a bounded depth calling a scoring routine and tightening a bound on each pass. It finishes by polling a stored flag until it changes.

name: check_score_threshold_flag
description: Returns zero when a search-state word is zero. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns zero when a stored score is below another stored score while a side-indexed flag equals one, and one in all other cases.

name: reset_and_locate_both_kings
description: Resets 24 pairs of stored entries to a sentinel value, sets two king-square words to minus one, then scans each side's squares for a king-type piece and records its square for that side.

name: evaluate_root_with_flag
description: Sets a flag word from a stored byte, clears a second word, and calls a routine with the parameter. It stores that routine's result in a search word only while the second word is still zero, then returns the result.

name: note_missing_routine_body
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The routine has 122 instructions, is called by two routines and calls four listed routines, so its behaviour cannot be stated from this evidence.

name: run_move_selection_stages
description: Steps through move-selection stages numbered zero to three, storing the stage in a state word and calling routines at each stage: a stored candidate first, then a second candidate class, then the remaining moves from the piece list. It returns as soon as a stage reports success.

name: search_moves_with_cutoff
description: Runs one level of a recursive move search: it records the position in a ply stack limited to twenty-three entries, tries each candidate by making and unmaking it, negates the returned score, and stops early on a cutoff. It returns a value that depends on the bounds stored in the search state.

name: record_killer_move_slots
description: Stores a move in one of two per-ply slots, moving the previous first slot into the second when the new move differs and a flag is set. A called routine compares the moves.

name: try_stored_move_candidates
description: When a search-state word is nonzero, it tests the stored move for the current ply with a called routine, and otherwise it tries the two per-ply candidate slots in turn. It returns one on the first candidate that passes and zero when none do.

name: update_bound_if_improved
description: Returns zero unless the parameter is at most a stored bound. When it is, it returns one and raises a second stored word to the parameter if that word is smaller.

name: score_candidate_move_in_search
description: Scores one move during the search by storing its value in the search state, applying a special case for piece type five, and comparing the material and position values against stored bounds. It returns one on a cutoff and zero otherwise, and calls five routines.

name: adjust_root_move_bonus
description: At the first ply it classifies two values into one of four bands and adds a scaled bonus to two state words. It returns one when the ply count and a called result are beyond their limits, and zero otherwise.

name: store_ply_result_pair
description: Copies a stored pair into a per-ply table entry after a called routine. At the first ply it saves the bound word and, for piece type five, stores the root result.

name: search_piece_type_sweep
description: Marks the current ply, calls a routine for each piece-type value from two to five, and returns one as soon as a call succeeds. It clears the mark and returns zero when none succeed.

name: try_piece_moves_with_callback
description: Stores a piece's square and type into the ply table, then tries its king-direction destinations and the destinations from the piece list, calling a callback for each candidate. It returns one at the first success.

name: try_moves_by_piece_type
description: Stores a piece's square and type in the ply table, then tries each reachable square by type: single steps for type one, ray sweeps for types two to four, an offset set for type five, and king steps for type six. It returns one at the first square a called routine accepts.

name: test_two_stored_move_pairs
description: Copies each of two stored pairs in turn into the ply table entry and tests it with a called routine. It returns one as soon as a pair passes that test and a second check, and zero when neither pair does.

name: try_king_midpoint_moves
description: When the previous move was a king move scoring above thirty-one, it tries the squares around the midpoint of the two stored squares, returning one when a called routine and a second check both succeed.

name: unwind_ply_stack
description: Records the current ply, then steps back through the saved plies one entry at a time, swapping the two side indices and calling a routine on each entry. It repeats that call once more when a flag is set.

name: replay_ply_stack_forward
description: Optionally calls a routine on the next ply entry, then steps forward through the saved plies up to the recorded depth, calling a routine on each and swapping the two side indices.

name: handle_pending_message_state
description: Calls several routines, then when a pending state word is nonzero it either sends a fixed message code through a handler or, when the state equals two, sets a result flag. It clears the state afterwards. The referenced text is 'Jay was wrong #1'.

name: execute_move_and_emit_commands
description: Applies a move to the board table, including castling, promotion and capture handling, and sends a sequence of movement commands through function-pointer calls for the moving piece, any rook and any captured piece. The routine is very large, so only its top-level flow is described here.

name: initialise_two_handler_slots
description: Registers two handlers by calling a routine with a table address and a slot number of seven and eight, storing each returned value in its own state word.

name: run_two_routines_if_clear
description: When a stored flag word is zero, it calls two routines in sequence. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: queue_channel_command_block
description: When a stored flag is set, it writes a block of eight words to a fixed memory area: a command code, a bit pattern, an address derived from the parameters and a stored byte. The block differs according to whether the parameter word is zero.

name: program_audio_channel_registers
description: Programs a sound channel by writing a fixed pattern of values to the audio channel registers and the DMA enable and interrupt registers, with a different pattern for the second channel. Writes with bit fifteen set enable the feature and writes without it disable it.

name: program_audio_channel_zero
description: Programs sound channel zero, taking its address, period and volume from a sample structure, then writes a fixed pattern to the channel registers and to the DMA enable and interrupt request registers.

name: set_audio_dma_channel_bits
description: Writes a channel bit and an enable bit to the DMA and interrupt registers, choosing channel one or two from a parameter word, then calls a library routine with a fixed argument.

name: set_audio_channel_zero_dma
description: Writes the channel zero bits to the DMA and interrupt registers, then calls a library routine with a fixed argument.

name: enable_both_audio_channels
description: Sets the DMA enable bits for audio channels zero and one and clears their volume registers, then passes two stored values to a library routine as slots eight and seven.

name: init_sound_object_first_use
description: Sets one field of a sound object to 256 and increments a use counter. On first use it stores a pointer and the value fifty in two fields; on later uses it sets two other fields to 256 and 2.

name: store_sound_pointer_fields
description: Stores a stored pointer and the value fifty in two fields of a sound object.

name: init_alt_sound_first_use
description: Sets one field of a sound object to 128 and increments a separate use counter. On first use it stores a pointer and the value fifty in two fields; on later uses it sets two other fields to 128 and 1.

name: store_alternate_sound_pointer_fields
description: Stores a stored pointer and the value fifty in the second pair of fields of a sound object.

name: lookup_indexed_value_with_limit
description: Returns zero when a stored index is at least ninety-six. Otherwise it scans a list of masked entries for a match, reads a value from a table at the index, and adds two hundred and twenty-four to it through a bitwise OR when a flag is set.

name: lookup_masked_table_value
description: Scans a list of masked entries for a match against a mask in a structure, reads a value from a table at the index, and sets the high bits when a flag is set.

name: open_trackdisk_port
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not shown. The referenced strings name the trackdisk device and a fatal message about failing to create a disk port or access a drive, and the routine calls five listed routines.

name: store_word_pair_then_zero
description: Stores the two 16-bit halves of its 32-bit parameter in two consecutive global words, then writes zero to the next global word.

name: store_longword_then_zero
description: Writes its 32-bit parameter to a global word and writes zero to the following global word.

name: transfer_data_in_512_blocks
description: Processes a length in blocks of 512 units: it handles a first partial block, then repeats a routine call for each full 512-unit block, and finally any remainder, advancing a pointer and a global offset each time. Two routines are called per block.

name: iterate_512_unit_chunks
description: Repeats a routine call for each 512-unit chunk of a length, advancing the chunk address and a global count. The entry lies in a gap that decodes as code, so its use is not confirmed by a caller.

name: copy_512_unit_chunks
description: Loops over a length in 512-unit steps, calling a routine with a source and destination pair at each step and advancing both. The entry lies in a gap that decodes as code, so its use is not confirmed by a caller.

name: dispatch_stored_handle_action
description: When a stored value is zero and a second stored handle is nonzero, it calls two routines and then one routine with a fixed address and the handle. Otherwise it calls a routine with the stored value.

name: dispatch_handle_with_fixed_address
description: When a stored handle is nonzero, it calls two routines and then a routine with a fixed address and the handle.

name: round_and_update_allocation_size
description: Rounds a stored size up to a multiple of 512 and adjusts a derived size. When the size changes it calls a routine and stores the new value; otherwise it calls a routine with the size and a value whose low nine bits are cleared.

name: queue_block_transfer_request
description: Writes a request of four words to a fixed area: a command code, a block size of 512, a second value and the first parameter scaled to block units, then calls a routine to submit it.

name: queue_block_request_type_three
description: Writes a four-word request with command code three, a block size of 512, a second value and the first parameter scaled to block units, then calls a routine to submit it.

name: retry_disk_command_until_success
description: Repeatedly issues a disk command and, while the result is nonzero, calls a message routine with a fixed code and retries. The referenced text reads 'Disk is write protected, try again.'

name: forward_single_routine_call
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, so it is a thin wrapper.

name: wait_for_game_disk_insert
description: Polls a drive status value and, while it reports that no disk is present, calls a message routine and retries after a short delay of three hundred units. The referenced text reads 'Insert the BattleChess disk.'

name: check_game_disk_header
description: Saves a block of fourteen words, issues a block request, checks the result and restores the saved words either way. It returns one when the check succeeds and zero otherwise. The referenced text is 'Battle Chess'.

name: check_save_slot_header
description: Saves a block of fourteen words, issues a block request sized from a global value, then reads from a second location and restores the saved words. It returns one on success and zero otherwise. The referenced text is 'ChessSaves'.

name: save_state_block_snapshot
description: Copies a fourteen-word block from the stack frame into a fixed memory area, calls one routine and returns one.

name: copy_state_block_and_clear
description: Copies a fourteen-word block from the stack frame into a fixed memory area, clears a global word and returns zero.

name: save_state_block_snapshot
description: Copies a fourteen-word block from the stack frame into a fixed memory area, calls one routine and returns one.

name: queue_command_four_request
description: Writes command code four to a global word and calls a routine with a fixed address.

name: set_status_nine_and_notify
description: When a stored status word is zero, sets it to nine, clears a second word and calls a routine with a fixed address.

name: return_minus_one_status
description: Sets a global word to minus one and returns it. The entry lies in a gap that decodes as code, so it may be a fixed return value rather than a called routine.

name: load_disk_record_header
description: Fills a 129-byte local buffer by calling a library routine with a large constant offset, then passes the buffer and a parameter to a routine, sets two bytes to eight and twelve, and passes 32 bytes to another routine.

name: wait_for_saves_disk_insert
description: Polls a check routine and, while it fails, calls a message routine with a fixed code and retries after a short delay of three hundred units. The referenced text reads 'Insert the ChessSaves disk.'

name: pause_when_flag_set
description: When a stored word is nonzero, it waits for a delay of three hundred units through a library routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: clear_global_status_word
description: Writes zero to a global word and returns.

name: load_saved_game_slots
description: Reads a 512-byte block of saved-game data and, when the read fails, calls a message routine with the referenced text 'No games saved.' Otherwise it marks eight slot records and loops over input events until a done event or a chosen slot ends the loop, then restores a flag.

name: run_load_game_menu
description: Builds the load menu: it copies a fourteen-word block, marks eight slot records and repeatedly reads input events, either opening the chosen slot or leaving when done. The referenced text is 'Load'.

name: run_slot_selection_loop
description: Continues the slot-selection loop: it reads input events, updates the chosen slot record, calls routines to show it, and exits when the done value is reached.

name: resume_slot_selection_loop
description: Enters the slot-selection loop after a slot has been chosen, reads input events and updates slot records, and exits through the common cleanup when done.

name: poll_menu_event_loop
description: Replies to the previous message, waits for the next one through library calls and reads its class and code values. It loops until a message of class sixty-four arrives, then records the slot value and passes the event on.

name: repeat_menu_selection_until_change
description: Loops over menu events and repeats the selection branch while the stored slot value is unchanged, reading each event through library calls and updating the record from its code value.

name: cycle_slot_selection_entry
description: Re-enters the slot-selection cycle with a cleared slot value, reading menu events until a slot is chosen, the done value arrives or a selection takes the branch that leaves the menu.

name: handle_menu_selection_branch
description: Handles one menu selection by branching on the slot value: a chosen slot is confirmed through library calls and the menu leaves when done, otherwise the event loop continues.

name: finish_slot_selection_cleanup
description: Finishes the slot selection: it calls a routine with the selected slot's record, restores a flag if the slot value changed, clears the select bit in eight slot records and returns.

name: run_save_name_entry
description: Runs the save-name entry screen: it reads key events into a fifteen-byte buffer, handles the backspace and return keys, caps entry at fourteen characters and passes the finished name to a routine. The referenced text is 'Save'.

name: resume_name_entry_input
description: Continues the save-name entry loop from its key handling: it refreshes the cursor and text position, then processes each key event by appending a character, removing one on backspace or ending entry on return.

name: handle_name_entry_keys
description: Handles one key event in the save-name entry loop: backspace moves the cursor back, return passes the typed name on, and any other key is appended up to a fourteen-character limit before the next event is read.

name: reset_name_entry_cursor
description: Clears the entry cursor position and reads the next input event, repeating the event handling while the entry is still in progress.

name: commit_typed_save_name
description: On a return key with a non-empty name, copies the typed characters into the chosen slot record and draws them through library calls before returning. Other keys are appended to the buffer, which is capped at fourteen characters.

name: poll_name_entry_events
description: Waits for and reads the next input event on the name-entry screen, records its position, then processes key and button events in a loop until entry ends.

name: append_name_character_and_poll
description: Appends the typed key character to the name buffer, capped at fourteen characters, then waits for and reads the next input event and processes it.

name: toggle_name_cursor_and_poll
description: Toggles the blinking cursor character at the end of the name buffer between a vertical bar and a space, redraws the text, then reads the next input event.

name: show_name_cursor_and_poll
description: Sets the cursor character at the end of the name buffer to a vertical bar, redraws the text, then reads the next input event in the same loop.

name: reset_name_flag_and_poll
description: Clears the name-entry active flag, then runs the event loop, reading the next input event for the name screen.

name: select_slot_for_name_entry
description: Switches the name-entry target to the slot at the current selection. If another slot was active it redraws that slot's name and the entry line, then starts editing the new slot, returning when the done event arrives.

name: finish_name_entry_and_draw
description: Ends name entry for the active slot by terminating the typed buffer and calling a routine to store it, then draws the finished slot entry and returns.

name: run_name_entry_event_loop
description: Enters the name-entry event loop, reading input events and dispatching key and selection events until the done event ends the loop.

name: select_slot_and_poll_events
description: Selects the slot under the cursor, redrawing the previous slot's entry when the selection changes, then waits for the next input event in the slot-selection loop.

name: finish_slot_draw_and_return
description: Clears the editing cursor when editing is active, then draws the selected slot's entry through a routine if one is chosen, and returns.

name: switch_slot_and_poll_events
description: Records the selected slot as the current target, draws its entry through a routine, then enters the input-event loop.

name: handle_name_key_events
description: Dispatches message classes in the name-entry loop. A key-class event edits the name buffer for backspace, return or a typed character, a gadget-class event selects a slot, and other classes clear the state; the next event is then read.

name: draw_slot_entry_and_poll
description: Draws the selected slot's entry at its screen position and then reads input events, returning when the entry is complete.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work in the body.

name: copy_name_text_with_length
description: Clears a buffer through a library call, copies a source string into it with a routine, writes a space just past the measured end, and returns that length.

name: is_printable_ascii_char
description: Returns one when the character code lies between space and tilde, the printable ASCII range, and zero otherwise.

name: build_active_slot_index_table
description: Clears an eight-row, sixteen-byte table through a library call, then copies each slot whose flag byte is set into the next row, records that slot's index in the row and stores the count of active slots.

name: build_active_slot_index_table
description: Clears an eight-row, sixteen-byte table through a library call, then copies each slot whose flag byte is set into the next row, records that slot's index in the row and stores the count of active slots.

name: collect_active_slot_indices
description: Copies each slot whose flag byte is set into the next row of the table, records the slot index in that row and stores the count of active slots, without clearing the table first.

name: draw_load_slot_list
description: Draws the load-slot list: a header from a routine, then eight slot rows each showing a stored name or a row of dashes, and a footer line with the selected count. The referenced text includes 'Load' and a row of dashes.

name: draw_menu_frame_rectangles
description: Sets the colour index, draws a rectangle at the origin and a second rectangle at fixed coordinates through library calls.

name: draw_menu_text_items
description: Sets a text colour and draws three or four fixed text entries from table offsets, adding a fifth entry when the parameter is nonzero.

name: draw_cancel_done_buttons
description: Draws the button label text at fixed positions, choosing a four-character or six-character string according to the parameter. The referenced text includes 'Cancel, Done'.

name: draw_rectangle_outline
description: Builds the five corner points of a rectangle from a two-by-two coordinate pair and draws them as an outline through library calls.

name: open_display_window
description: Opens the display window from a stored window definition through a library call and keeps the handle. When the handle is zero it reports 'unable to open a window.' and returns a false result; otherwise it returns true.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value one with no other work.

name: close_display_window
description: When a window handle is set, closes that window through a library call, makes a second library call with two constant arguments, clears the handle and calls a routine.

name: read_fixed_file_block
description: Opens a file with a fixed identifier through a library call. On success it reads a 512-byte block into the parameter buffer and closes the file; otherwise it clears the buffer through a library call. It returns true when the file opened.

name: call_pair_then_return_one
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns one.

name: read_second_fixed_file_block
description: Opens a second fixed file through a library call and, when it opens, reads a 512-byte block into the parameter buffer and closes it. A flag word selects an extra routine call before opening, and the function returns true when the file opened.

name: call_pair_then_return_one
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns one.

name: write_save_name_header
description: Clears the first byte of a buffer and, when a flag word is zero, writes the save-file label through two routines before writing it again. The referenced text is 'ChessSaves:'.

name: initialise_request_structure
description: Fills a structure with zero fields, a type byte of two and the two parameter values, then passes it with a second parameter to a routine.

name: initialise_serial_port
description: Calls a library routine to obtain a resource, points two buffer fields at a fixed offset, then writes fixed values to the serial period and interrupt registers.

name: send_serial_bytes
description: Writes a byte string to the serial data register one byte at a time, waiting for the transmit-buffer-empty flag before each byte and setting an extra high bit on every byte.

name: transmit_serial_byte_run
description: Transmits a run of bytes through the serial data register, waiting on the transmit-buffer-empty flag between bytes and stopping when the count reaches zero.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without any work, so the body is empty.

name: receive_serial_bytes_with_timeout
description: Reads bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into the caller's buffer, polling a timer routine for a timeout window before each byte. It returns zero when the full count has been read and minus one when a byte does not arrive in time.

name: read_serial_ring_buffer_run
description: Copies bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into a buffer until the requested count is reached, polling a timer routine for each byte. It returns zero on completion and minus one on timeout.

name: return_negative_one
description: Returns the constant minus one with no other work.

name: read_serial_ring_buffer_timed
description: Reads bytes from the serial receive ring buffer, polling a timer routine for each byte within a timeout window. It returns zero when the count is complete and minus one on timeout.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns the value zero with no other work.

name: flush_serial_receive_buffer
description: Sets the serial receive read index equal to the write index, discarding any unread bytes.

name: count_serial_receive_bytes
description: Returns the number of unread bytes in the serial receive ring buffer, adding the buffer size of one hundred and twenty-eight when the write index has wrapped.

name: compute_ring_buffer_wrap_distance
description: Computes the number of bytes between a stored index and the receive read index, adding the buffer size of one hundred and twenty-eight when it wraps, and stores and returns the result.

name: enable_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Writes the receive-buffer interrupt bit to the interrupt enable register and calls a library routine with interrupt number eleven and a stored handle.

name: queue_serial_transmit_byte
description: Stores one byte in the serial transmit ring buffer at the write pointer, wrapping the pointer to the start of the buffer at its end, and sets an interrupt-request value.

name: send_packet_with_checksum_retry
description: Builds a two-byte checksum from the packet bytes, sends the packet and checksum through a transmit routine, then waits for a reply. One reply value sends the packet again, another ends the exchange, and any other reply reports a message.

name: send_packet_and_await_reply
description: Adds the packet bytes into a checksum, sends the packet and checksum, then waits for one of two reply bytes. The matching reply repeats the send, and an unexpected reply reports a message.

name: receive_reply_packet
description: Waits for up to four reply bytes through a receive routine, answering the expected reply with a transmit call. An unexpected reply reports a message code and returns, otherwise the routine returns once the count is reached.

name: report_simultaneous_send_retry
description: Reads up to four reply bytes and answers a matching reply with a transmit call. When a reply is unexpected or the count is exceeded it reports a message code. The referenced text is 'Sending at the same time...try again'.

name: await_opponent_reply
description: Waits for up to four reply bytes, answering matching replies through a transmit routine and timeouts with an error value. When the count runs out it reports a message code. The referenced text is 'Opponent not responding'.

name: parse_incoming_packet
description: Reads an incoming packet, checks its header nibble for the expected type and its length byte for a limit of forty, and computes a checksum over the body. It compares the trailer with a fixed pattern, then acts on the packet type, taking one branch for one type value and another for the rest.

name: verify_packet_trailer_and_reply
description: Compares the two trailer bytes of a packet with the expected pair. When they match it sends one of two reply codes depending on a mode flag and the packet type, or accepts a second packet type that carries a value; it returns zero when the trailer does not match.

name: receive_packet_with_timeout
description: Sets a link-state flag and reads incoming bytes in a loop, classifying each byte as a packet header, a line ending or a control value. It returns minus one when no data arrives in time.

name: send_reply_then_receive_packet
description: Sends a reply code chosen by a link-state flag, then runs the packet receive loop and returns minus one on timeout.

name: send_fixed_code_then_receive
description: Sends a fixed reply code, then runs the packet receive loop and returns minus one on timeout.

name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero immediately without any other operation or memory access.

name: dispatch_link_code_then_receive
description: Dispatches on an incoming link code: one value sends a reply code chosen by a link-state flag, another sets the link flag, and any other value ends the routine. It then runs the receive loop and returns minus one on timeout.

name: receive_text_or_packet_lines
description: Receives bytes in a loop, collecting printable text lines terminated by a carriage return and recognising packet headers. It returns minus one when no data arrives in time.

name: start_link_and_receive
description: Starts the link by calling a routine and setting the link-state flag to one, then runs the receive loop and returns minus one on timeout.

name: receive_text_line_stream
description: Waits for input in a loop, storing incoming printable characters until a carriage return and ending each line with a zero byte. It returns minus one when the wait times out.

name: process_modem_text_line
description: Cuts an incoming text line at a carriage return and reports the line through a routine unless it is the modem command 'ATE'. It then reads the next input byte and returns minus one on timeout.

name: receive_modem_response_line
description: Clears a terminator byte, checks the line for the modem command 'ATE' and reports any other unexpected line, then receives input bytes and handles packet headers. It returns minus one on timeout.

name: start_link_and_parse_packets
description: Calls a routine, sets the link-state flag to one, then parses incoming bytes for packet headers, text lines and control values, returning minus one when no data arrives in time.

name: send_link_reset_sequence
description: When either of two link-status words equals two, sends a fixed two-byte sequence followed by a 38-byte block through a transmit routine.

name: send_status_packet_from_fields
description: Builds a four-byte packet from a type byte of 162, a length of six and two bytes taken from the source structure, then sends it through a transmit routine.

name: send_short_command_packet
description: Builds a two-byte command with the code 169 and the value five, then sends it through a transmit routine.

name: send_sync_code_clear_flag
description: Sends a fixed four-byte code through a transmit routine and clears the link-state flag.

name: fill_buffer_with_countdown
description: Writes one byte per step into the buffer, counting down from the parameter count minus one to zero.
